title: Fibocom Showcases Robotic Mower, AI Device and Wireless Connectivity Solutions at electronica 2026
description: MUNICH, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- At electronica 2026, Fibocom is showcasing how its connectivity, AI and robotics technologies support device development, offering OEMs options ranging from wireless modules and PCBA designs to application-specific algorithms and system integration support. Fibocom Showcases Robotic Mower, AI Device and Wireless Connectivity Solutions at electronica 2026 Robotic Mower Solutions for Different Design Needs Fibocom's robotic mower portfolio covers three sensing and navigation architectures: a lightweight monocular-vision solution without LiDAR or RTK, designed for cost-optimized products; monocular vision with 3D LiDAR for complex, obstacle-rich gardens; and stereo vision with RTK for depth perception and high-precision positioning across larger lawns. Beyond sensor selection, Fibocom provides core hardware, proprietary perception and navigation algorithms, and system integration support, helping manufacturers build on existing solution architectures. The robotics showcase also features development kits and stereo camera hardware from D-Robotics. AI Companion Solutions for Consumer Devices Fibocom's AI companion solution provides integrated hardware and software capabilities, combining the MagiCore core unit, AI Cloud, app, IP Agent customization, and connectivity and AI token services. Fibocom also supports complete device customization and delivery, helping customers accelerate AI companion product development. AiMOON, a zodiac-themed AI companion toy developed by a customer using MagiCore, demonstrates how the solution can be integrated into character-based consumer products. Wireless Modules and Board-Level Solutions For broadband and portable connectivity, Fibocom is presenting 5G CPE and outdoor unit (ODU) PCBA solutions, alongside MiFi and Dongle designs. These include a 5G RedCap MiFi powered by RU311 and a separate portable RedCap device featuring FG132. At the component level, Fibocom's portfolio also includes LE270 and LE271 LTE Cat.1 bis modules, the low-power IoT module MQ771, and the MGB GNSS series. Customer devices on display cover applications in asset tracking, industrial monitoring and remote health monitoring. The showcase also features an AI smart pet collar that combines Fibocom cellular connectivity with pet tracking, activity monitoring and AI-based pet vocalization recognition. For OEMs, Fibocom offers different levels of integration-from wireless modules and board-level designs to specialized hardware, algorithms and engineering support-according to their product development needs. About Fibocom Fibocom, founded in 1999, is China's first wireless communication module company listed on both the A-share and H-share markets. Fibocom leverages wireless communication and artificial intelligence as its core technologies to provide integrated hardware and software solutions that empower industry applications. These solutions accelerate the transformation from "Connect Everything" to "Intelligent Connectivity" across diverse industries. Fibocom's one-stop solutions encompass cellular communication, AI, automotive, and GNSS modules, as well as AI toolchains, supporting industry-side and mainstream large model integration, and providing AI Agent, global connectivity, and cloud services, driving the digital intelligence upgrades in industries such as robotics, consumer electronics, low-altitude economy, intelligent transportation, smart retail, and smart energy.
